content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Oil India Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Oil India Graduate Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Graduate Teacher posts at Oil India is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Graduate Teacher posts?
faq.answer: For Graduate Teacher (Fine Arts), a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts is required. For Graduate Teacher (Physical Education), a Bachelor's degree in Physical Education with a minimum of 50% marks is necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Graduate Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for all Graduate Teacher posts is between 18 years to 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Graduate Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Contractual Graduate Teacher (Fine Arts) is Rs. 21450 per month. For Contractual Graduate Teacher (Physical Education), it is Rs. 21450 plus a variable of Rs. 825 per day.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Graduate Teacher posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Graduate Teacher posts, with one each for Fine Arts and Physical Education.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Graduate Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in for Personal Assessment, followed by the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for Oil India Graduate Teacher posts being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Duliajan, Assam. The specific venue details are usually provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to carry any documents to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Graduate Teacher posts are on a contractual basis, as indicated in the job type.
